description: Upload or replace the code of an app YOU own: one entry document (content: HTML or JavaScript, max 512 KB), or a bundle of files (files: index.html plus the JavaScript, CSS, images, fonts and further HTML pages it loads by relative path, max 50 files, 1 MB each, 2 MB in total; images and fonts base64). A new upload replaces the whole bundle of that version. autario stores it and serves it inside a locked sandbox with no outbound network access, so the app reads World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, SEC and connector data through autario.js (autario.query, autario.datasets, autario.artifacts) rather than calling anything itself; autario inlines the SDK into the served page, so a script tag for https://autario.com/autario.js is optional. Re-uploading the same version replaces it in place. Use it to ship a new build of an app you created with create_app, or to fix one after a user reports something.

app_id.description: Id of an app you own, as returned by create_app. An app you do not own answers not found.

content.description: The entry document itself (one HTML file), or index.html when you also send files. Give content, files, or both.

content_type.description: Type of content when it is the only file. Default text/html.

files.description: A multi-file app: index.html plus every file it loads by relative path (e.g. "app.js", "css/style.css", "img/logo.png", "about.html"). Paths are relative, use "/", no "..". Allowed: html, js, mjs, css, json, svg, png, jpg, webp, woff2. Max 50 files, 1 MB each, 2 MB in total. Put index.html in this list or pass it as content. Links between the HTML pages work, every page gets autario.js.

content.description: The file: text as is, binary (images, fonts) as base64 with encoding "base64".

path.description: Relative path inside the app, e.g. "js/app.js".

version.description: Optional version label this bundle belongs to.

name: upload_app_bundle
